decisions.reason: Authorization to publish the approved current batch does not change the monthly quota, its counting rule, or its cadence.
The posting instruction is consistent with the existing rule that approved clips may be published and does not change the approval authority, eligibility rule, or rejected-clip handling.
Publishing the approved current batch does not alter the qualification method, required trial count, success condition, or deadline.
The instruction to post approved clips does not change Lead Clipper responsibilities, assignment status, training, or advancement conditions.
Publication authorization does not modify any caption color, font, effects, lettering, or positioning standard.
The source message concerns posting already approved clips and does not change which source videos may be used.
The publishing instruction does not change the required or approval-eligible clip duration.
Authorization to post the approved batch does not modify the completeness, teaching-value, standalone, or audience-comprehension criteria.
The source message does not change the clean-editing, effects, or transition requirements.
The instruction to publish approved clips does not alter the standard for selecting strong source moments.
The requested link is a link to the clips after publication, not a change to the Google Drive or planned Notion workflow used to submit clips for review.
Publication authorization does not change the requirement to remove distracting wind noise.
